title: The Botched Surgery
logline: A disgraced underworld doctor hires a pilot to secure evidence of a rival gang's tampering before a notorious crime boss realizes their surgery was sabotaged.

roles.description: Brilliant but constantly trembling, prone to terrible decisions under pressure.
A filthy, unlicensed medical bay hidden in an asteroid.
A heavy bruiser ship looking to finish the boss off.
The loose network of illegal ripperdocs.

public_situation: The {role:wounded_boss} survived a massive assassination attempt and is currently recovering at an undisclosed location.
private_truth: The boss is recovering at the {role:clandestine_clinic}, but the doctor accidentally paralyzed their legs and is terrified of the consequences.

beats.public_change: The doctor sends a panicked, encrypted distress call.

missions.reason: The doctor hires the pilot to rush experimental stabilizers to the clinic to keep the boss unconscious while the doctor preps their own ship to flee.
missions.private_fact: The doctor left the boss completely unattended on the operating table to buy time.

beats.public_change: Rival gang members locate the clinic and launch an assault.

missions.reason: The doctor begs the pilot to destroy the rival enforcers to cover their escape.
missions.private_fact: The doctor actually leaked the clinic's coordinates to the rivals to ensure the boss dies.

beats.public_change: The boss wakes up, realizes they are paralyzed, and issues a massive bounty on the doctor.

missions.reason: The doctor realizes the rivals recorded their comms and demands the pilot blow open the wreckage to retrieve the logs.
missions.private_fact: The logs prove the doctor arranged the hit.

beats.public_change: The pilot holds the logs, and the boss's personal guard arrives.

missions.reason: The boss demands the pilot return to the clinic and deliver the logs to prove the doctor's treason.
missions.private_fact: The doctor begs the pilot to dump the logs into the nearest star so they can safely escape on their own ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the logs to the boss.
resolutions.summary: The boss executes the doctor. The pilot is paid a massive bounty, and the boss rules their syndicate from a wheelchair.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the logs and escapes with the doctor.
resolutions.summary: The doctor escapes the system and starts a new life. The boss is enraged and puts a permanent mark on the pilot.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot saved a dirty ripperdoc from the wrath of a paralyzed crime boss.

resolutions.summary: The boss succumbs to their wounds. The syndicate fractures, and the doctor is hunted down by loyalists.

loose_threads.detail: The 'botched' surgery was performed using high-end corporate surgical tools that were deliberately miscalibrated.
The rival enforcers were paid out of an account managed by the boss's own second-in-command.

radio_hooks: Underworld in chaos following assassination attempt on {role:wounded_boss}.
Unlicensed medical clinics raided across the sector.

voice_direction.wounded_boss: Guttural, in immense pain, but radiating authority.
